title: Global approaches to tackling antimicrobial resistance: a comprehensive analysis of water, sanitation and hygiene policies
what_the_paper_is: analysis of WASH-related antimicrobial-resistance policy across 193 countries (policy mapping); the outcome is AMR policy coverage
note: strong legal-mapping content, but no access outcome

title: Estimating the cost of interventions to improve water, sanitation and hygiene in Indian healthcare facilities
what_the_paper_is: survey of 32 healthcare facilities to cost WASH upgrades nationally (ingredients-based costing)
note: cost estimation; no legal or governance factor

title: Protocol for development and validation of instruments to measure women's empowerment in sanitation
what_the_paper_is: a protocol for scale development and validation (ARISE scales); no results

title: Escaping the Capitalist Black Hole: dethroning Mammon and liberating water
what_the_paper_is: Research Note: a conceptual synthesis of five years of hub research in four countries, with no data presented in the note

title: Transando el agua, produciendo territorios e identidades indigenas
what_the_paper_is: political-ecology study of water-rights transactions (Chilean Water Code 1981) and interviews with Atacameno urban leaders in Calama
note: empirical and legal, but the water traded is for farming and mining rather than household supply; E07 stands under the narrow reading

title: Co-developing evidence-informed adaptation actions for resilient citywide sanitation
what_the_paper_is: co-production research with local governments of four Indonesian cities listing climate adaptation actions for sanitation systems (planning, institutions, financing, infrastructure)
note: governance content, but the outcome is adaptation actions, not access

title: Integral assessment of the effectiveness of water resource management in communities
what_the_paper_is: SWOT and composite-index study of community water-resource management (nine indicators; index 0.382)
note: sustainability index; access percentages are inputs only

title: Exploring the impact of reclaimed water on Latin America's development
what_the_paper_is: systematic review and meta-analysis of the economics of reclaimed water and wastewater regulation in Latin America
note: wastewater reuse markets, not household access; note it is a systematic review by design

title: COVID-19: urgent actions, critical reflections and future relevance of 'WaSH'
what_the_paper_is: narrative review of WaSH in disease emergence and COVID-19 prevention
note: narrative review without a stated method

title: Capacity building for water management in peri-urban communities, Bangladesh
what_the_paper_is: role-playing simulation game workshop on drinking-water institutions in Khulna; outcome is participant learning

title: Assessment of the urban water security in a severe water stress area
what_the_paper_is: SWARA risk index of water security for five Palestinian cities with water-service indicators (coverage, losses, continuity) and governance indicators (roles, information, stakeholder engagement)
note: E06 (engineering) fits poorly: the index mixes service and governance indicators; no access outcome is measured, so E04 is the better label

authors_year: Meng et al. 2026 (Journal of Environmental Engineering Technology, Chinese)
title: Spatiotemporal distribution and countermeasures of rural domestic sewage treatment facilities in tropical islands of Hainan
what_the_paper_is: field survey of 741 rural sewage treatment facilities in 18 cities and counties (treatment rate 80.1%, 48.6% of facilities with operating problems, maintenance models)
note: engineering and operations survey; governance appears only as the maintenance-operator model

title: Determining the opinions of women living in the earthquake zone on the physical and psychosocial problems after the 2023 Kahramanmaras earthquake
what_the_paper_is: qualitative interviews with 15 women; hygiene (toilet and bathroom) is one issue among many

title: Measuring the total factor productivity of the Portuguese water and sewerage services
what_the_paper_is: Malmquist total-factor-productivity study of utilities by ownership and rurality
note: efficiency measurement; no access or legal factor

title: Water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH): the evolution of a global health and development sector
what_the_paper_is: document review and 19 expert interviews on seven decades of the global WASH sector
note: sector history, not an access-barrier study
